benchmark_iterator: benchmark a python iterator for N iterations with warmup and max time seconds
benchmark_dataset_speed: benchmark the speed of taking raw samples from a detectron2 dataset
benchmark_mapper_speed: benchmark the speed of mapping raw dataset samples in a single process
benchmark_dataloader_workers: benchmark the dataloader by tuning num_workers to different candidate values
benchmark_distributed_dataloader: benchmark the dataloader across distributed GPU workers and log per-GPU results
